summary: Backend-only iteration 2 testing for reservation cancel/memory, order flow end-to-end, and new Chef Voice Notes feature. Added 15 new focused tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2_features.py plus re-ran full regression from iteration 1. All 38 backend tests passed (15/15 new + 23/23 regression = 100%).

minor.issue: No 404 handling when rid does not exist — silently returns null. Also accepts arbitrary status values (no enum check) unlike orders endpoint.
Size guard uses len(audio_base64) only; does not verify base64 validity or content. Message truncated to 280 chars silently.
Returns full audio_base64 payload in list — could be heavy. Consider returning meta only and streaming audio via separate endpoint.

action_items: (Non-blocking) Add enum validation to PATCH /api/reservations/{id}/status like orders endpoint (only allow confirmed/seated/completed/cancelled).
(Non-blocking) Return 404 from PATCH /api/reservations/{id}/status when reservation id not found.
(Non-blocking) Consider excluding audio_base64 from GET /api/voice-notes list — payload could be large with many notes.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 737 lines — approaching threshold for splitting into modules (auth, orders, reservations, voice_notes routers).
PATCH /api/reservations/{id}/status has no status enum validation nor 404 handling (bug-prone).
Voice-note broadcast notification is created even on empty message/dish_name — message becomes 'New chef's note — tap to listen' which is fine but consider suppressing empty ones.
audio_base64 stored inline in Mongo; may bloat DB. Fine for MVP but flag for later refactor to GridFS/S3.
seed_data_creation: None — used seeded demo accounts and menu. Test data prefixed with TEST_.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 backend is fully green. New test file test_iteration2_features.py covers: reservation create+list memory across requests, reservation PATCH cancel (staff-only, RBAC verified, table auto-freed), order flow guest→placed→preparing→ready→served, bill retrieval, voice-notes CRUD with RBAC (chef create/delete OK, customer 403 on create/delete), voice-notes public listing sorted desc, 400 size guard >2.5MB base64, customer notification broadcast on new voice note. Frontend changes (CustomerMenu no-match banner, Reservations cancel UI, ChefVoiceNotes recorder, VoiceNotesPlayer) were not tested this round (per request: backend only).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all iteration-2 fixes verified working. Bug 1 (reservation error + memory): POST returns confirmed reservation with id; subsequent GET /api/reservations returns all past reservations for the customer including newly created ones (confirmed via 2 sequential POSTs). Bug 3 (order flow): full lifecycle placed→preparing→ready→served works with correct math (subtotal + 5% tax + 5% service = total) and bill retrievable via bill_id. Bug 4 (voice notes): all 7 sub-tests pass — create/list/delete/RBAC/size-guard/notification broadcast.
